facts.fact: UNHCR says that as of 30 June 2026 around 30,400 refugees and asylum-seekers in Benin were individually registered, and that under the World Bank-supported COSO project 8,481 asylum-seekers were registered and 2,337 issued vital protection documents in northern Benin, while 2,450 in the south hold valid documents.

UNHCR says it convened two quadripartite meetings with SP-CNRA, WURI and ANIP in January 2026 to validate terms of reference and set a roadmap for biometric enrolment of refugees and asylum-seekers in the National Registry of Physical Persons, still to be operationalised in the second half of 2026.
